description: Figure 2 illustrates the validation perplexity for three large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—after pruning with different values of M at a fixed 70% sparsity, using the OWL method. The x-axis represents the pruning parameter M, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, in increments of 5. The y-axis represents validation perplexity, with a linear scale ranging from 20 to 35, in increments of 1.  There are three lines shown: a blue solid line representing LLaMA1-7B, which starts at approximately 32.8 at M=0 and decreases to approximately 24.5 at M=70; a green dashed line representing LLaMA1-13B, which begins at approximately 28.5 at M=0 and decreases to approximately 22.2 at M=70; and a red dotted line representing Vicuna-7B, which starts at approximately 30.2 at M=0 and decreases to approximately 23.8 at M=70.
